anchor_value: USD cost valuation; EUR marker belongs to Par/Shares

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Header places Par/Shares (3), Cost (25), and Fair Value (1)(26) in separate columns.
First Lien Secured Debt - Term Loan | E + 525, 0.00% Floor | 01/07/31 | EUR marker | 95 | 98 | 106 | (9)(22)

findings.detail: The non-USD marker is the par/share denomination, but the extracted cost_currency is U_EUR for a BDC cost valuation that should remain USD.

rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 single-cell currency validation issue. The raw schedule header separates Par/Shares from Cost and Fair Value, and the cited EUR row puts the foreign-currency marker in the par/share position while cost and fair value are the valuation amounts. Therefore a stored cost_currency of U_EUR is a real localized extraction/unit bleed defect, not a correct source value.
